speaker: will_kemp
text: You have a writing look, Will. What is in the sleeve? If it is a laugh, I will forgive the week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sleeve is empty. What is in my hand is the comedy. Navarre's cues, and nothing folded under them.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art somewhere else behind the eyes. I know the look. Give me the boards that are here, and keep the somewhere else at home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The boards that are here are thine and mine both. I am not reading thee a new part off a sheet I did not bring.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, the sheet he did not bring is not a cost. Item, the door is still dark. Item, Easter Monday is four days off, and four days is the date we already have.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Four days, and one book. I have not been offered a paste this morning, which is how I like a Thursday. If there is ink on your finger, Will, keep it off my plot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The ink dried at home. Your plot is the comedy. I will not write in the margin of it today.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam is not singing this pass. He can speak his other lines if they come. I am not spending the cuckoo twice in a week when Monday must have it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not spend it. I did not come up to hear it. I came to walk an entrance and go back.

speaker: will_kemp
text: An entrance is a poor gift to a man with a hat. You used to come with something I could lift. An empty sleeve is a new habit, and I do not admire it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Admire the habit or not. You are not getting a new line out of a sleeve. The part you have is the part you play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave him the hat, Will. Thou hast said the sleeve is empty. I believe thee, which is more than I do on most Thursdays. Walk Navarre, and let me find Berowne where I left him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Find him. Nothing for thee off a page. The page is upstairs, and it is not coming down to be shown.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Upstairs may keep its own counsel. Item, we are not a committee of sleeves. Rehearse the book we have, and stop before dinner becomes a debate.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book we have agrees with itself. I checked the slip. It holds. I do not want a second opinion from a poet with ink on his cuff.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No second opinion. The cuff is dry. I am walking the entrance from the door to the post, and then I am done.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The boys can hold their places without a song. Arthur knows where he stands. I am not teaching a new note on a dark Thursday.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then teach nothing. I will stand where the plot has always put me, and I will not scratch at a sheet I have not been shown. There. I am reasonable. Write it down, or do not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. Reasonable is enough. I am not carrying your reason home to a page.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. Go home when the entrance is walked. I have Berowne. Thou hast Navarre. The dark door can wait four days for the both of us.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Four days. Item, that is the end of the accounting. If you are going, go before Kemp becomes reasonable a second time. It unsettles the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going. The sleeve is empty. The book is one book. I will see you when the door is a door and not a rehearsal.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: One book when you go, as when you came. I will not open a second to keep you.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor I. Walk, and leave the somewhere else on the stair at home.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Empty sleeve. I have said I will not scratch at it. Do not make me say it twice. Go.
